outputs.article:
Brothers and sisters, when fear grips your heart, remember that perfect love casts out fear
Why This Matters
Most people face this without understanding it. Jesus said to His disciples, "Why are you afraid Will you trust Him
The Reality
 This is where many stay trapped.
How It Works
Teaching opens with personal vulnerability and transforms through encounter with Christ.
The Turning Point
Until something changed.
What Became Possible
 This is not theory. This is transformation.
Divine Authority
Jesus Christ is the answer.
Scripture Support
John 10:10 - I have come that they may have life abundantly
Romans 6:9 - Christ dies no more; death has no dominion
2 Corinthians 5:17 - If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation

EPISODE TITLE: From Bondage to Breakthrough
Brothers and sisters, when fear grips your heart, remember that perfect love casts out fear In this episode we explore how people rationalize their bondage and how true transformation comes through direct encounter with God.
KEY TAKEAWAYS
1. Brothers and sisters, when fear grips your heart, remember that perfect love casts out fear
2. Jesus said to His disciples, "Why are you afraid
3. Will you trust Him
SCRIPTURE
• John 10:10 - I have come that they may have life abundantly
• Romans 6:9 - Christ dies no more; death has no dominion
• 2 Corinthians 5:17 - If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation
